verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs say it decodes JavaScript source maps. Maps are fetched automatically when public, or uploaded manually through the JS source map center or an API that uses an external access token. The API path could be scripted from CI, but the evidence never mentions a dedicated CLI or a bundler plugin. Missing for 10: an official upload CLI, a webpack/Vite/Rollup bundler plugin, a documented CI upload workflow, and independent or hands-on confirmation that de-minified traces work.
